overall_goal: Weigh shredded lettuce, monitor the cooking chicken, and cut the cooked chicken into smaller pieces.

goals.description: Transfer shredded lettuce to the weighing scale.
goals.rationale: The person moves shredded lettuce from a sieve into a bowl on the scale to weigh it.

goals.description: Wash hands and put away the sieve.
goals.rationale: The person places the empty sieve in the sink and washes their hands after handling the lettuce.

goals.description: Check the chicken and wipe hands.
goals.rationale: The person uses tongs to check the cooking chicken and then wipes their hands with a rag.

goals.description: Log the weight of the lettuce and clean the scale.
goals.rationale: The person writes down the lettuce's weight in a notebook, turns off the scale, and wipes it clean.

goals.description: Clear space on the chopping board and prepare utensils.
goals.rationale: The person repositions the chopping board, moves tongs and lettuce pieces aside, and handles a knife and fork.

goals.description: Clean up the chopping board and wash hands.
goals.rationale: The person scrapes lettuce bits off the fork, gathers them from the board to throw away, and washes their hands.

goals.description: Monitor the chicken cooking and turn off the hob.
goals.rationale: The person repeatedly checks the chicken in the pan using tongs, adjusts the pan, and finally turns off the electric hob.

goals.description: Prepare the workspace for cutting the cooked chicken.
goals.rationale: The person moves the bowl of cooked chicken to the chopping board, puts the tongs in the sink, and clears space.

goals.description: Cut the first batch of cooked chicken into smaller pieces.
goals.rationale: The person uses a knife and fork to pick up and cut several large pieces of cooked chicken into smaller chunks.

goals.description: Cut the second batch of cooked chicken into smaller pieces.
goals.rationale: The person continues to pick up large pieces of chicken from the bowl and cuts them into smaller pieces on the board.

goals.description: Cut the remaining cooked chicken into smaller pieces.
goals.rationale: The person finishes cutting the last large pieces of cooked chicken into smaller chunks.
